Design.evidence_source: The sessions were one-shot, between-subjects, gender balanced, with at least 16 participants present.

country.evidence_source: The experiment took place at the Experimental Laboratory at the Technical University of Berlin from July 2016 to August 2017.

info_cost.evidence_source: Participants completed a brief quiz to make sure they understood the instructions. To be certain that participants fully understood that the Reveal button depicted both players' payos and that the Continue button only showed the own payo in the After treatment, the last two questions of the quiz focused on these two buttons.

Sample.evidence_source: A total of 736 students participated across the ve treatments with exactly half (368) playing the role of a dictator (Player X).
Sample.warning: Specific (Tmt x Ctr) comparison cell counts for selfish/altruistic choices are not reported in this section.
